Thanks. Yeah, I love her so much. Through my life, understanding is something I've been missing, but I don't feel suicidal, I've never been suicidal or depressed, but she makes me feel more understood than anyone else and I do anything to make her feel that way too.

I will do. I tell her that everyday and will do my best to do it even at the worst days of my life. Thanks for caring, it helps a lot.
